method: Installed image tool generated a pigment drawing. Only its pigment mask was reduced and blended with a fixed earth palette onto bare ancestor rock. All source rock and shading were discarded. No ancestor image was regenerated. A deterministic final wear pass leaves fine pigment gaps and varies opacity to retain the rock texture.
visualReview: Explicitly inspected final full wall and 512-pixel JPEG. Warm rock, cracks, framing, light and all ancestral marks remain. Pepe retains wide mouth, heavy-lidded eyes and both unchanged five-digit hands (four fingers and one thumb each). New worn ochre seed forms contain pale pigment spots; no new hands, handprints, letters, numbers, captions, logos, borders or prohibited symbols observed. New motif is subtle at thumbnail size.
deliveryNote: The explicitly required beside-record JPEG is the sole new image outside artifacts/. The generated intermediate WebP was removed; its replacement PNG draft was overwritten by the finished full wall.
